# Acme Retail

> GENERATED by stackra gen (docs target) from docs.json and services/commerce/stackra.manifest.json; never edited
> by hand. A commerce platform built on Stackra: one service (catalogue, inventory, orders, loyalty), a console, a
> mobile app, a public site.

## API (from @acme/service-commerce 0.1.0; Stackra-Version 2026-10-01, 2027-03-01)

- catalogue.product.get_by_slug@1 (query) — GET /public/products/by-slug/{slug} — public, L0; refusals: product_not_found
- catalogue.product.list_storefront@1 (query) — GET /public/products — public, L0
- catalogue.product.search@1 (query) — GET /public/products/search — public, L0
- catalogue.product.get@1 (query) — GET /products/{productId} — app, catalogue.product.read, L0; refusals: product_not_found
- catalogue.variant.get_by_barcode@1 (query) — GET /variants/by-barcode/{barcode} — app, catalogue.product.read, L0; refusals: variant_not_found
- catalogue.variant.search@1 (query) — GET /variants — app, catalogue.product.read, L0
- catalogue.product.archive@1 (action) — PUT /products/{productId}/archive — app, catalogue.product.archive, L2, policy ProductPolicy.archive, offline queue; refusals: not_found, forbidden
- catalogue.product.attach_image@1 (action) — POST /products/{productId}/images — app, catalogue.product.update, L1; refusals: product_not_found, upload_expired, upload_bucket_mismatch, upload_incomplete
- catalogue.product.create@1 (action) — POST /products — app, catalogue.product.create, L1; refusals: limit_reached
- catalogue.product.update@1 (action) — PATCH /products/{productId} — app, catalogue.product.update, L1
- catalogue.product.list@1 (query) — GET /products — app, catalogue.product.read, L0
- inventory.stock.adjust@1 (action) — PUT /stock/{variantId}/locations/{locationId} — app, inventory.stock.manage, L2, policy StockPolicy.manage; refusals: forbidden
- inventory.stock.list_low@1 (query) — GET /stock/low — app, inventory.stock.read, L1
- orders.order.create@1 (action) — POST /orders — app, orders.order.create, L1, Idempotency-Key required, offline queue; refusals: orders_paused, variant_unavailable, insufficient_stock, insufficient_points, rate_limited
- orders.order.cancel@1 (action) — PUT /orders/{orderId}/cancel — app, orders.order.cancel, L2, policy OrderPolicy.cancel; refusals: forbidden
- orders.order.expire_unpaid@1 (action) — cron */5 * * * * — app, orders.order.expire, L2
- orders.order.get@1 (query) — GET /orders/{orderId} — app, orders.order.read, L0, policy OrderPolicy.read
- orders.order.list@1 (query) — GET /orders — app, orders.order.read, L0
- orders.order.list_lines@1 (query) — GET /orders/{orderId}/lines — app, orders.order.read, L0, policy OrderPolicy.read
- orders.order.stats_today@1 (query) — GET /orders/stats/today — app, orders.order.read, L0
- loyalty_kit.account.enroll@1 (action) — PUT /loyalty/accounts/{accountId} — app, loyalty_kit.loyalty_account.enroll, L1; refusals: not_own_principal
- loyalty_kit.points.redeem@1 (action) — POST /loyalty/redemptions — app, loyalty_kit.loyalty_account.redeem, L1, Idempotency-Key required; waits up to 15m for confirmation, then credits the points back; refusals: not_a_member, insufficient_points, workflow_timed_out, rate_limited
- loyalty_kit.points.confirm_redemption@1 (action) — PUT /loyalty/redemptions/{reference}/confirm — app, loyalty_kit.loyalty_account.redeem, L1; keeps the debit of a pending redemption
- loyalty_kit.account.freeze@1 (action) — PUT /loyalty/accounts/{accountId}/freeze — app, loyalty_kit.loyalty_account.freeze, L2, policy LoyaltyAccountPolicy.freeze; refusals: forbidden, not_found
- loyalty_kit.points.expire@1 (action) — cron 0 3 * * * — app, loyalty_kit.loyalty_account.expire, L2
- loyalty_kit.points.balance@1 (query) — GET /loyalty/accounts/{accountId}/balance — app, loyalty_kit.loyalty_account.read, L0, policy LoyaltyAccountPolicy.read
- loyalty_kit.points.stats_today@1 (query) — MCP tool only — app, loyalty_kit.loyalty_account.read, L0

## Events

- orders.order.placed.v1: orderId, customerId, totalMinor, currency, lines
- orders.order.paid.v1 (webhook): orderId, customerId, paymentId, totalMinor, currency
- orders.order.cancelled.v1: orderId, customerId, reason
- catalogue.product.archived.v1: productId, variantIds
- inventory.stock.low.v1 (broadcast to sessions holding inventory.stock.read; not a webhook): variantId, locationId, available
- loyalty_kit.account.enrolled.v1: accountId, memberId, tier
- loyalty_kit.points.earned.v2 (v1 also published until 2027-04-01): memberId, points, reference, tier, balanceAfter
- loyalty_kit.points.redeemed (domain event, not public): memberId, points, reference
- loyalty_kit.account.frozen.v1: accountId, memberId, isFrozen
